 New Delhi, Nov 21 (PTI) The BJP on Saturday appointed national office bearers of the party’s OBC Morcha.
 In a statement, the BJP said Jogen Mohan from Assam, Mamata Mohanta from Odisha, Sangam Lal Gupta from Uttar Pradesh, Babanrao Raoji Chaudhary from Maharashtra, Sat Prakash Rana from Delhi, Arjun Sahni from Bihar and Sangeeta Balwant Bind from Uttar Pradesh were appointed as vice presidents of the morcha.
 Gajendra Yadav from Delhi, Pramod Madhwaraj from Karnataka and Lalit Chandrakar from Chhattisgarh were made national general secretaries of the BJP OBC Morcha.

 The BJP also appointed seven new national secretaries and other office bearers of the morcha. PTI PK MNK
